structuralFix.why: three consecutive review rounds found the SAME defect — a key present in one operation branch's list and absent from another's (role: update-only; the reset fence: no delete; manualOverride: delete-only). Root cause: each key set was written out once per branch, so editing one copy left the others behind.
structuralFix.what: every repeated key set is now a rules FUNCTION called by all branches — serverLabelKeys(), resetFenceKeys(), serverOwnedSubcollections(), serverOnlyAttemptKeys(). Divergence is now structurally impossible rather than merely discouraged.
structuralFix.proof: pure refactor + the new guards: matrix 213/213 green, all 12 mutants killed, and M12 (dropping manualOverride from the shared list) breaks create, update AND delete cases at once.
